name: Drawer
summary: A panel that slides in from an edge of the screen, on the native <dialog>, and becomes a bottom sheet on phones.
description:
Use a drawer for filters, settings or a detail view that people open beside their work. It slides in from the end edge by default; .v-drawer-start suits navigation, and top and bottom make sheets.

Like the dialog, open it with showModal() and close it with <form method="dialog">.

classes.name: v-drawer
classes.description: The drawer, on a <dialog>. Slides in from the end edge; on phones it becomes a bottom sheet.

classes.name: v-drawer-start
classes.description: Slides in from the start edge and stays a side drawer on phones, for navigation.

classes.name: v-drawer-top
classes.description: A full-width sheet from the top edge.

classes.name: v-drawer-bottom
classes.description: A full-width sheet from the bottom edge, at every width.

classes.name: v-drawer-header
classes.description: Top row with the title and the close button.

classes.name: v-drawer-title
classes.description: The heading. Point aria-labelledby at its id.

classes.name: v-drawer-close
classes.description: The close button, usually a ghost icon button inside <form method="dialog">.

classes.name: v-drawer-body
classes.description: The content. Only this part scrolls.

classes.name: v-drawer-footer
classes.description: The actions, with a border above. On phones the buttons share the width.

states.description: Set by showModal(). The drawer slides in; without it the drawer is hidden.

keyboard.action: Moves focus between the controls inside. Focus stays in the drawer while it is open.
Presses the focused button. A button in <form method="dialog"> closes the drawer.

a11y: Open with showModal() so the page behind is inert and focus is trapped; focus returns to the trigger on close.
Name it with aria-labelledby pointing at the .v-drawer-title, and give the icon-only close button an aria-label.
Start and end follow the writing direction, so the drawer comes from the correct side in right-to-left pages.

examples.title: Filters drawer
examples.description: Opens from the end edge on wide screens and as a bottom sheet on phones. Add .v-drawer-start, -top or -bottom for another edge.
